parts.gloss: they will not (negative third person plural)

literal: Even in a time lacking resources, from benevolence they will not shrink, those who have the vision of knowing their duty.
translation: Even in times of destitution, those who possess the clear vision of duty do not shrink from their benevolence to society.
modern: வறுமைக்காலத்திலும், கடமையை உணர்ந்த அறிவுடையவர்கள் பிறருக்கு உதவி செய்யும் ஒப்புரவுப் பண்பிலிருந்து பின்வாங்க மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet explains that true benevolence is a matter of character and vision, not just material wealth. The phrase 'கடனறி காட்சியவர்' refers to wise individuals who have a clear, deep understanding of their duty to the community. Even during 'இடனில் பருவம்'—a period when they lack personal resources or face poverty—they do not shrink ('ஒல்கார்') from performing acts of social benevolence ('ஒப்புரவு'). Their commitment to helping others remains steadfast regardless of their financial situation.
